description.value: Domino's is a national pizza chain franchise offering delivery and carryout from its Nanaimo location on Norwell Drive. The menu covers pizza, wings, pasta, cheesy bread, and desserts, with a gluten-free crust option available. As a takeout-and-delivery-focused operation, it provides no dine-in seating or dedicated cyclist facilities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is an active Domino's Pizza franchise at 3394 Norwell Dr, Nanaimo, BC V9T3Y7, matching OSM address and phone. The coupons page lists a 'Small 2-Topping Gluten Free Pizza' option confirming a GF menu item. As a chain fast-food delivery operation, it offers no distinguishing cyclist services.
